verdict.rationale: Jan is a local LLM runner powered by llama.cpp, so controlling context memory allocation across concurrent model instances is a fair axis for it. However, the evidence pack contains no documentation of context-size settings, KV-cache allocation, or running multiple models concurrently. The llama.cpp mention and the general 'full control' marketing line do not address this capability.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can control how context memory is allocated when running multiple model instances concurrently
